messages:
Alex K: FYI escalating NimbleAI onboarding to CS — priority: P1. Renewal in ~28 days and the customer is blocked from going live. Writing up quick context below.

Devon L: TL;DR — recent model upgrade changed embedding space, ingestion pipeline throwing backfill errors for ~12% of docs, and SSO provisioning flakey (403s intermittently). Also saw tokenization mismatch on a subset of records. Latency spikes in eu-west-2 during ingestion windows (~600ms -> 2s).

Maria S: On it. Need a short handoff checklist and owner list so we can message the customer and set expectations. Who owns the exec comms?

Alex K: Owner: Raj P for account exec comms, Maria for technical CS lead. AE contact is Kyle (AE) — he’s already on the thread with the customer.

Raj P: Thanks. Quick ask: can we assemble a 48hr remediation comms plan + 7-day followup? I want a recommended cadence we can send to the customer.

Maria S: Proposed comms & ops checklist (first draft):
• Immediate: send acknowledgement email within 30m with P1 triage plan and single point of contact (Maria).
• 0–48h: daily 30-min sync until ingestion stable.
• 48h–7d: daily async updates + 2x weekly 30-min checkins as stability improves.
• 7d+: 1-week postmortem + quantified risk/next-steps before renewal.

Devon L: Adding technical details for handoff (logs/snippets):
```
INGEST_ERROR: backfill failed for batch id=bf-2026-03-20-12
error: "embedding mismatch: checksum != expected" count=124
node eu-west-2/gpu-1 latency_ms=2012
SSO: token exchange 403 at auth-proxy-03
```

Devon L: Also include config snapshot: `model: open-embed-v2`, `quant: q4_0`, batch_size=64, prefix_cache=true. We suspect the open-embed-v2 vector drifted after the last finetune.

Maria S: Ops checklist (expanded) — short bullets we can paste to customer: 
• Who: Maria S (CS lead), Devon L (Support eng), Raj P (AM), Kyle (AE)
• What: triage embeddings drift, fix ingestion backfills, validate SSO provisioning, mitigate latency spikes
• When: ack now, daily sync for 48h, status by EOD each day
• How we’ll measure progress: percent backfill success, avg ingestion latency, SSO auth error rate
• Temporary mitigation options: rollback to previous embedding model (open-embed-v1), reduce batch_size to 16 for backfill, route traffic to eu-central-1 if latency persists

Alex K: Customer-facing short email draft (we should tweak):
"Hi Team — we’ve prioritized your onboarding as P1. Maria will be your CS lead and will coordinate daily updates. Immediate next step: 30-min triage call within 60 minutes. We will share a remediation plan and ETA for backfill completion within 24 hours"

Raj P: Perfect. I'll send the email once Maria confirms the call slot. Also looping legal for any data-handling notes if we do rollback.

Maria S: Confirmed — I can do triage at 11:15 UTC. Agenda: 1) quick recap of symptoms 2) plan to mitigate 3) agree SLAs and comm cadence 4) assign owners.

Kyle (AE): I’ve told the customer we’ll be in touch and that we’ll own the ops until they’re unblocked. They’re available for the 11:15 UTC slot.

Maria S: Action items captured: 
- Devon: capture failing doc IDs and escalate to infra if backfill cluster OOMs (ACTION: collect sample and open infra ticket)
- Devon: provide short rollback playbook for open-embed-v1 (ACTION: paste steps in thread)
- Alex: draft customer acknowledgement email and send after we confirm 11:15 slot (ACTION: send)
- Raj: coordinate legal & AE on exec comms (ACTION: notify legal)
- Maria: run triage call + own daily syncs until resolved (ACTION: lead)

cs-bot: Reminder set — triage call at 11:15 UTC (calendar invite sent to participants).

Maria S: I'll post a short ops runbook after the call with runbook steps, rollback commands, and a progress dashboard link. Will update thread within 2 hours post-call.

Devon L: quick note — if we rollback, we need to gauge embedding diff: run `python tools/embed_diff.py --old open-embed-v1 --new open-embed-v2 --sample 10000` and capture recall delta.

Raj P: Great. Thanks team — let's keep updates concise in this thread and sync after the triage.

Alex K: +1. Marking priority and tagging renewal watch.
